statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks. The requested URL redirects to https://new3.hdhub4u.cl/.

page.notes: Public movie/download listing. Requested new2 host redirects to new3. Representative templates: home listing, category listing, release detail/download entry, request form, and 404 recovery.

artifacts.caption: Home under dark and reduced-motion preferences
Compact trace timings and long tasks
Home metadata, links, forms and CSS probe
Focus, semantics and platform feature probe

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-color-scheme light and dark screenshots plus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Light and dark captures are pixel-identical; the root color-scheme computes to normal and the stylesheet contains no prefers-color-scheme query.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion reduce and queried active animations and media rules
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduce condition matched, the stylesheet includes reduced-motion rules, and document.getAnimations() returned no active animations under reduction.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/media inspection and keyboard focus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No forced-colors or prefers-contrast rules were found, and focused primary controls computed to outline-style none.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/platform feature probe across MPA navigation surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS or cross-document @view-transition rule was present despite frequent listing-to-detail navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS and animation inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface exists, so there is no scroll-linked work to implement declaratively.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface exists, so there is no scroll-linked work to implement declaratively.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited surfaces expose ordinary links, forms, and menu buttons, with no swipe, drag, carousel, pull-to-refresh, or other gesture interaction.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited surfaces expose ordinary links, forms, and menu buttons, with no swipe, drag, carousel, pull-to-refresh, or other gesture interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page screenshots and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 15,515px home page has no progress indicator or scroll-state-aware chrome, and no scroll-state container query was present.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS overlay probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, contextual menu, or other tethered overlay was present on representative surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, contextual menu, or other tethered overlay was present on representative surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual walkthrough of home, detail, category, and request paths
checkOutcomes.evidence: Section headers, category chips, a visible home link, and descriptive detail headings preserve orientation across representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots at desktop and mobile
checkOutcomes.evidence: No modal or full-viewport interstitial obscured content on initial load; the domain notice remains in normal flow.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probe for dialog, popover, and details plus interaction review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No modal/transient overlay was used; navigation toggles are native buttons, so no ad-hoc dismissible overlay was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshots at 360x800 and 1440x1000
checkOutcomes.evidence: On mobile, logo, poster strip, two navigation rows, and a domain notice consume roughly the first 470px before page-specific content; the request task begins below that repeated chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout metrics and screenshots at 360x800 on three templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, category, and detail layouts report scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 with zero horizontal overflow and include a viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature inspection and multi-template mobile screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cards reflow at viewport breakpoints, but no @container/container-type rules were found; the CSS relies on a large set of global width queries.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus walk, target measurement, and Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused menu/search/link controls computed outline-style none; the category toggle measured 22x22px and Lighthouse failed target-size.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport and detail walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing identifies Latest Releases, cards use specific titles, and the detail page clearly labels DOWNLOAD LINKS and available resolutions.

checkOutcomes.method: Home-to-detail walkthrough and destination-link inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: A release card reaches a detail page with direct, labeled resolution links; the request path provides a comment form. External download destinations were inspected as hrefs but not opened for safety.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid form submission and deliberate 404 request
checkOutcomes.evidence: Blank required fields invoke browser validation, while a missing route returns HTTP 404 and renders an explicit 404 Page Not Found state with navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile Lighthouse plus DevTools trace and layout observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.23s (poor), while trace LCP was 2.67s; the slower controlled mobile run establishes a material load-performance risk.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers across representative templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: The detail template accumulated CLS 0.10137, driven mainly by a 0.09786 shift at about 3.56s; all 63 home images lacked explicit dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace and layout long-task observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, a longest task of 458.99ms, and 413.68ms total blocking time; mobile Lighthouse was faster, so severity is moderated.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live head script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transferred 4.60MB in 137 requests; ten parser-inserted styles/scripts were candidates, and live DOM confirmed jQuery, jQuery Migrate, Lottie, and reaction scripts are synchronous in head.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR resource inventory and script inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Twelve scripts transfer 468,919 bytes, including two Google analytics loaders and synchronous jQuery, jQuery Migrate, Lottie and reaction code on a largely static listing.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM form probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found an untitled slider iframe and many image-card anchors with no discernible name; home search inputs also have no programmatic label.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse color-contrast audit and visual screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse did not fail color-contrast, and representative white/colored text remains visually distinguishable against black surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse landmark audit, heading probe, and focus walk
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home page has no main landmark and no h1, and focused controls compute no visible outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop and mobile visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core card titles and detail copy remain readable without clipping at both widths; line wrapping is dense but comprehensible.

checkOutcomes.method: Narrow reflow metrics, viewport inspection, and Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow itself has no horizontal overflow and scaling is allowed, but Lighthouse failed touch-target sizing and the measured category toggle is only 22x22px.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse Runtime/Log audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse captured six 429 resource failures and an uncaught SyntaxError in script.min.js at line 2.

checkOutcomes.method: Doctype/charset probe, image primitive, and Lighthouse asset audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOCTYPE html and UTF-8 are present, but Lighthouse found incorrect image aspect ratios and all 63 inspected images omit width/height attributes.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices and inspector audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports inspector issues and five BFCache failure reasons, in addition to a runtime syntax exception.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered/raw metadata probes on home and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and detail pages have descriptive unique titles and a meta description; raw HTML preserves the description.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, DOM links, viewport metadata, and robots.txt
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0, internal links use hrefs, viewport metadata is present, and robots allows ordinary search crawlers.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP, DOM, robots, and sitemap inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home page has no canonical link although it redirects from new2 to new3; robots and sitemap are present, and the detail template does provide canonical.

checkOutcomes.method: JSON-LD and Open Graph inspection on home and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home entity has no JSON-LD and only og:type; the detail has BlogPosting JSON-LD and og:image but lacks a complete og:title/og:description share set.

checkOutcomes.method: Security headers, cookie, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used and no exposed secrets were found, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; four analytics cookies lack Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, tracker, and cookie inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: 120 of 137 requests and 4.26MB of 4.60MB are third-party; 20 third-party origins include Google Analytics, DoubleClick, popunder/ad hosts, and 400-day analytics cookies.

checkOutcomes.method: Permission/auth surface inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No authentication flow or geolocation/notification prompt exists on representative pages, so passkeys and permission timing do not apply.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authentication flow or geolocation/notification prompt exists on representative pages, so passkeys and permission timing do not apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Response-header and cookie-policy inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors was served; cookies use SameSite=None broadly.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw-HTML/rendered comparison and crawler screenshot pair
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML returns 200 with 100% rendered-content coverage and no empty JS mount; core listings survive without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative menu/form/route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Native links and controls remain usable at narrow width, no tethered overlays clip, and page content renders despite one third-party script failure.

checkOutcomes.method: Service-worker, cache, and manifest probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is a content/download MPA rather than an installed application. A service worker and cache exist, but no manifest is declared; installability is not required for this archetype.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a content/download MPA rather than an installed application. A service worker and cache exist, but no manifest is declared; installability is not required for this archetype.

checkOutcomes.method: Deliberate missing-route HTTP and screenshot test
checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing path returns a real 404 status and a visible 404 Page Not Found page with a route back home rather than a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and CSS property probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang is en-US, but dir is absent and CSS contains 356 left and 181 right declarations with no detected logical-property usage.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered date inspection and source/CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dates are rendered as hard-coded English strings such as Jul-24th, 2026 rather than semantic time elements with locale-aware formatting.

checkOutcomes.method: Content and form inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No appointments, event times, deadlines, recurring schedules, or other time-zone-sensitive concepts are exposed.
checkOutcomes.reason: No appointments, event times, deadlines, recurring schedules, or other time-zone-sensitive concepts are exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR/script inspection and DOM link snippets
checkOutcomes.evidence: Advertising/popunder scripts from gumcdn.com and septanepoints.com load, and Lighthouse DOM snippets show data-popunder-added attached to normal navigation/content links, making link behavior potentially deceptive.

checkOutcomes.method: Blank required-field submission on request form
checkOutcomes.evidence: The request form prevents blank submission and presents native, specific “Please fill in this field” validation for name and email.

checkOutcomes.method: Form/control attribute inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search fields explicitly set autocomplete=off, while name/email request fields provide no autocomplete tokens, preventing browser input assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: Journey inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription purchase, sign-in, account management, or cancellation flow is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription purchase, sign-in, account management, or cancellation flow is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and HAR byte inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: 62 of 63 images use legacy formats, 61 lack srcset, 57 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and images transfer 3.45MB.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and trace inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page eagerly fetches 96 images and 120 third-party requests, including analytics/ad work, while the trace records a 459ms long task after load.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party byte accounting
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 4.26MB of 4.60MB transferred; images, fonts, and duplicate analytics dominate a simple content listing.

checkOutcomes.method: Capability and site-intent inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public download listing exposes no safe transactional agent workflow, and adding WebMCP to third-party download actions would not be appropriate without a trusted capability model.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public download listing exposes no safe transactional agent workflow, and adding WebMCP to third-party download actions would not be appropriate without a trusted capability model.

checkOutcomes.method: Feature/source inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model interaction is part of the user experience, so on-device inference would add no established value.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model interaction is part of the user experience, so on-device inference would add no established value.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline and post-interaction heap summaries after ten menu open/close cycles
checkOutcomes.evidence: Total self size fell from 14,915,209 to 14,910,646 bytes; DOM nodes remained 857 in the in-page sample and no retained-growth signal appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary and Performance.memory/DOM sample
checkOutcomes.evidence: The static listing retained about 14.9MB self size and 857 live DOM elements, proportionate to its image-heavy content; no unbounded state was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after constructor and DOM-count comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reported Detached* among retained constructors; live DOM count stayed exactly 857 after ten menu cycles.

principleOutcomes.reason: This public download listing exposes no safe transactional agent workflow, and adding WebMCP to third-party download actions would not be appropriate without a trusted capability model. No summarisation or language-model interaction is part of the user experience, so on-device inference would add no established value.

paths.description: Entry/home listing and primary release discovery; represents global header, navigation, search, cards, and long feed.
Bollywood category listing; represents taxonomy/listing templates beyond the homepage.
Musafir Cafe release detail; represents content metadata, download-link discovery, and the key listing-to-detail journey.
Movie Request Page; represents the primary authored form and invalid-input state.
Deliberate unknown route; represents HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.summary: Fixed dark palette is not driven by the user color preference
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulations are visually identical; root color-scheme is normal and no prefers-color-scheme rule exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide light/dark tokens selected by prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast and forced-colors users receive no explicit support
findings.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast CSS exists and focused controls have no outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adjustments that preserve borders, text, and focus indicators.

findings.summary: MPA navigation swaps abruptly without cross-document view transitions
findings.evidence: No @view-transition or view-transition-name usage was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a progressive @view-transition rule and stable names for shared header/content elements, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Very long listings provide no scroll-aware orientation
findings.evidence: Home content is 15,515px tall but has no progress or scroll-state-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight scroll-state navigation or a progress/back-to-top affordance with container scroll-state queries.

findings.summary: Repeated site chrome delays page-specific content on mobile
findings.evidence: On 360px screens the logo, poster strip, dual navigation, and notice occupy about 470px before task content.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary chrome and defer or remove the decorative poster strip so each page purpose appears in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is tied to global viewport breakpoints
findings.evidence: No container queries are present despite reusable listing cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list containers containment and adapt card typography/layout with @container.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and some touch targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Primary controls compute outline none; a category toggle is 22x22px and Lighthouse fails target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and provide at least 44x44 CSS-pixel target areas.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is poor
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 7.23s LCP and 12.3s time to interactive.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, reduce initial image/font competition, and defer noncritical third-party code.

findings.summary: Detail pages shift as late content arrives
findings.evidence: Detail CLS reached 0.10137, with a 0.09786 shift at 3.56s; images omit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio for imagery and reserve space for late widgets/banners.

findings.summary: A post-load long task blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: The trace records a 458.99ms task and 413.68ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the late task, remove unnecessary plugin work, and split/defer remaining noncritical execution.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is crowded by synchronous scripts and ten blocking candidates
findings.evidence: 137 requests transfer 4.60MB; jQuery, jQuery Migrate, Lottie, and reaction scripts are synchronous in head.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused head dependencies, defer eligible scripts, self-host/subset fonts, and shorten the critical request chain.

findings.summary: Static listings ship disproportionate plugin and analytics JavaScript
findings.evidence: Scripts transfer 468.9KB, including duplicate analytics and legacy/plugin dependencies.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to remove unused plugin bundles and consolidate analytics to one deferred loader.

findings.summary: Content links and embedded slider lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds an untitled iframe and many focusable card anchors without discernible text; search lacks a label.
findings.suggestedFix: Title the iframe, give each link one accessible name, and add persistent or visually hidden labels to search fields.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading, and focus structure is incomplete
findings.evidence: Home has no main landmark or h1, and focus indicators are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main, add one descriptive h1, preserve logical heading order, and restore :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Touch target sizing fails despite otherwise successful mobile reflow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size fails and a measured navigation control is 22x22px.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase hit areas and spacing to at least 44x44 while preserving responsive reflow.

findings.summary: The page logs resource failures and an uncaught syntax error
findings.evidence: Lighthouse records six 429 failures and SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in script.min.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the malformed script and make plugin assets cacheable/reliably served without rate-limit failures.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic sizing and some render at wrong aspect ratios
findings.evidence: All 63 inspected images omit width/height and Lighthouse fails image-aspect-ratio.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and object-fit rules that preserve source proportions.

findings.summary: BFCache and DevTools hygiene checks fail
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports five BFCache failure reasons and Inspector Issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported BFCache blockers and inspector issues, then verify back/forward restoration.

findings.summary: The redirected home URL lacks a canonical signal
findings.evidence: new2 redirects to new3, but the rendered home page has no canonical link.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical for the final home URL and keep sitemap links aligned with it.

findings.summary: Share and structured metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: Home has no JSON-LD and only og:type; detail pages lack a complete Open Graph set.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite and content JSON-LD plus og:title, og:description, og:url, and og:image.

findings.summary: Baseline browser security policies are absent
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all missing; analytics cookies are insecure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict referrer/permissions policies, and Secure/Lax analytics cookies.

findings.summary: Third-party tracking dominates the page without minimisation
findings.evidence: 120 requests and 4.26MB are third-party across 20 origins; analytics cookies last 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit and remove nonessential origins, gate analytics on consent, shorten retention, and batch the minimum necessary telemetry.

findings.summary: Physical-direction CSS makes bidirectional adaptation brittle
findings.evidence: CSS uses hundreds of left/right declarations, no logical properties, and no explicit dir.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction appropriately and replace physical positioning/spacing with inline/block logical properties.

findings.summary: Dates are hard-coded English text rather than locale-aware values
findings.evidence: Detail displays “Jul-24th, 2026” without a semantic time element.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit machine-readable datetime values and format display text with Intl.DateTimeFormat.

findings.summary: Popunder code alters ordinary link behavior
findings.evidence: Ad scripts load from gumcdn/septanepoints and normal content links carry data-popunder-added.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove popunder interception and keep ads clearly labelled, separate, and consent-aware.

findings.summary: Forms disable or omit browser input assistance
findings.evidence: Search sets autocomplete=off and name/email fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow search history where appropriate and add name/email autocomplete tokens to request fields.

findings.summary: The image pipeline eagerly ships legacy, non-responsive assets
findings.evidence: 62/63 images are legacy, 61 lack srcset, and 57 below-fold images are not lazy loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, use srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold images, and keep the LCP image eager/high priority.

findings.summary: Background and below-fold work is fetched eagerly
findings.evidence: The page loads 96 images and 120 third-party requests before they are needed.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer offscreen rendering/fetching and pause nonessential analytics or animation work outside the foreground.

findings.summary: Third-party bytes are disproportionate to a simple listing
findings.evidence: Third-party assets are 4.26MB of the 4.60MB load, with images, fonts, and analytics dominating.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a template byte budget, self-host/subset essential fonts, reduce origins, and cache/defer proportionately.

taskList.title: Remove popunder interception and minimise third-party tracking
Deploy security headers and secure cookie attributes
Fix names, landmarks, focus indicators, and touch targets
Optimise and lazy-load responsive images while reserving dimensions
Reduce critical requests and defer unnecessary plugin code
Reduce repeated mobile chrome and improve component responsiveness
Complete canonical, structured, and Open Graph metadata
Fix runtime syntax, asset, and BFCache hygiene failures
Add preference, i18n, transition, and autofill refinements
